GRASSIMOTE

Open GrassiBoard on Windows

GrassiBoard Remote is not available right now. Open GrassiBoard on Windows, then go to Settings → Remote Control.

Connect your phone:
Scan the QR code shown in GrassiBoard, or enter the temporary six-digit pairing code manually.

Keep both devices on the same private LAN. If the PC received a new LAN IP, use the new QR code.
